coordination_utility.justification: While agents attempted to coordinate handoffs, they still experienced resource conflicts at the stove and only completed 1/11 task steps.

redundancy.justification: Communication was concise with only 7 messages and no trivial or repetitive chatter.

planning_coherence.justification: Proposed plans respected task dependencies, such as Robot_3 requesting vegetables to be cut before boiling.

failure_explanation_quality.justification: Robot_1 clearly explained its lack of the COOK skill, but Robot_2 failed to communicate an injected slip during cutting, and a stove resource conflict went unaddressed.

llm_judge_report.overall_summary: The team communicated clearly and relevantly, but failed to translate their plans into effective execution, missing critical failure explanations and struggling with physical coordination.
